definitions: Attach or fasten with a pin or pins.
Hold (someone or something) firmly in a specified position, especially so that they cannot move.
Identify and show precisely the position of (something).
Attribute (something, especially a crime or blame) to someone.
examples: She pinned the notice to the board.
He pinned the attacker to the ground.
Can you pin down the exact location?
They tried to pin the blame on him.
